title: How to build a skill
description: Guides users through creating a reusable Skill for repeatable work.

steps.title: Open Skills
steps.description: Select Skills from the side menu to open Skills.

steps.title: Add a Skill name
steps.description:
Enter a short, descriptive name using lowercase words seperated by hypens

Example: brand-guidelines

steps.title: Add a Skill description
steps.description:
Briefly describe what the skill does and where it can be used.

Example: Apply brand guidelines to presentations and documents.

steps.title: Prompt Instructions - add custom variable content
steps.description:
Define how the skill should work using Markdown. Complete each section of the template, including its purpose, when to use it, required inputs, two-step workflow, expected outputs, response guidelines, ground rules, and constraints. Replace all placeholder text and remove any guidance or examples that are not needed.

Template: <insert link to SKILL.md>

Tip: You may wish to work with Copilot or MyAssist to refine your Skill.

steps.title: Create Skill
steps.description: Select Create to create the Skill

steps.title: Upload your skill
steps.description:
Select Upload skill and navigate to your skill’s root folder. The system validates the folder structure and SKILL.md content before publishing.

Note: For guidance on how to structure your SKILL.md file and folder structure, refer to the relevant article in the MyAssist Academy.
